'''Malik Ti Derious Newman''' (born February 21, 1997)  is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[BC Avtodor|Avtodor Saratov]] of the [[VTB United League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball|Mississippi State Bulldogs]] and the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]]. He attended [[Callaway High School (Mississippi)|Callaway High School]] in [[Jackson, Mississippi]]. He helped lead Callaway to four straight victories in the MHSAA Class 5A boys basketball championship.<ref>[http://www.clarionledger.com/story/sports/high-school/2015/03/13/peat-newman-chargers-explode-second-half/70316630/ 4-peat: Newman, Chargers explode in second half]</ref><ref>[http://usatodayhss.com/2015/no-4-callaway-malik-newman-finish-off-fourth-consecutive-state-title No. 4 Callaway, Malik Newman finish off fourth consecutive state title]</ref> As a senior his jersey number 14 was retired by the school.<ref>[http://usatodayhss.com/2015/malik-newmans-high-school-retires-his-jersey-while-hes-still-an-active-player Malik Newman's high school retires his jersey while he's still an active player]</ref><ref>[http://www.slamonline.com/media/slam-tv/malik-newman-jersey-retirement-highlights-video/ Malik Newman Gets HS Jersey Retired, Drops 38 Points ]</ref>

==High school career==
[[File:20150401 MCDAAG Malik Newman bringing the ball upcourt (2).JPG|thumb|left|Newman at the [[2015 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2015 McDonald's All-American Game]]]]
Newman attended [[Callaway High School (Mississippi)|Callaway High School]] in [[Jackson, Mississippi]] all four years of his high school basketball career. As a junior, Newman scored 25 points, 6 rebounds, and 2 blocks to defeat Vicksburg High School to win the 2014 Mississippi Class 5A Championship. 
In August 2014, Newman was [[FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup Most Valuable Player|named the MVP]] of the [[2014 FIBA Under-17 World Championship]].<ref>[http://www.clarionledger.com/story/recruitingreport/2014/08/16/usa-u17-wins-gold-newman-mvp/14164111/ Malik Newman leads USA to Gold, earns MVP honors]</ref> As a senior, Newman averaged 29.7 [[Points per game|points]], 5.7 [[Rebounds per game|rebounds]], and 4.2 assist per game while leading the Chargers to a (31–3) overall record. Newman was selected to play in the [[2015 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]],<ref>[http://www.clarionledger.com/story/prepsreport/2015/01/28/malik-newman-mcdonalds-all-american/22491057/ Callaway guard Malik Newman named to McDonald's All-American roster]</ref> [[Jordan Brand Classic]], and [[Nike Hoop Summit]]. He was rated by [[Rivals.com]] as a five-star recruit and was ranked as the eighth best overall player,<ref>[https://n.rivals.com/prospect_rankings/rivals150/2015 Rivals.com 2015 Rivals150]</ref> while [[ESPN]] ranked him 10th overall in the Class of 2015. Newman committed to [[Mississippi State University]] to play college basketball.

==College career==
===Mississippi State===
On April 24, 2015, he signed to play college basketball at [[Mississippi State University]],<ref>{{cite news |last1=Cronin |first1=Courtney |title=Five-star prospect Malik Newman chooses Mississippi State |url=https://www.clarionledger.com/story/mississippistatesports/2015/04/24/msu-five-star-malik-newman-chooses-mississippi-state/26303501/ |access-date=October 25, 2018 |publisher=Clarion Ledger |date=April 24, 2015}}</ref> where his father, Horatio Webster, played from 1997 to 1998.<ref name = "kuathletics bio">{{cite web|title=MALIK NEWMAN|url=https://kuathletics.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/malik-newman/1074|website=kuathletics.com| date=July 2016 |access-date=October 25, 2018}}</ref>   During his freshman season he averaged 11.3 points per game.

===Kansas===
On July 1, 2016, he decided to transfer and committed to play at the [[University of Kansas]]. Per [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] regulations, he [[Redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] during the Jayhawks [[2016–17 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|2016–2017 season]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Malik Newman Transfers to Kansas|date=July 2016 |url=http://kuathletics.com/news/2016/7/1/mens-basketball-malik-newman-transfers-to-kansas.aspx}}</ref>

In his first and only season with the Jayhawks, Newman averaged 14.2 points, 5.0 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game and was named Big 12 Newcomer of the Year.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://kuathletics.com/cumestats.aspx?path=mbball&year=2017&|title=2017-2018 Men's Basketball Cumulative Statistics - University of Kansas Athletics|website=kuathletics.com|language=en|access-date=March 26, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=211704001|title=Men's Basketball All-Big 12 Awards Announced|work=Big12Sports.com|access-date=March 26, 2018}}</ref> On March 25, 2018, Malik scored 13 of the Jayhawks' points in overtime and finished with a career-high 32 to lead the Jayhawks to the [[NCAA Final Four Tournament|NCAA Final Four]] in a victory over [[Duke University]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=211707808|title=Newman's huge OT powers KU to Final Four|work=Big12Sports.com|access-date=March 26, 2018}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Sioux Falls Skyforce (2018–2019)===
After going undrafted in the [[2018 NBA draft]], Newman signed a two-way contract with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] on July 1, 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/Article/NBA-Draft-2018-Undrafted-Malik-Newman-signs-two-way-contract-with-Los-Angeles-Lakers-119256493/|title=Report: Undrafted Malik Newman signs two-way deal with Lakers|date=June 21, 2018|access-date=June 22, 2018|last=Chasen|first=Scott}}</ref> Following the conclusion of the Summer League, the Lakers released him on July 19.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/releases/180719-lakers-waive-malik-newman|title=Lakers Waive Malik Newman|work=NBA.com|date=July 19, 2018|access-date=July 19, 2018}}</ref>

On August 6, 2018, Newman signed an Exhibit 10 contract with the [[Miami Heat]].<ref>{{cite web |title=HEAT Signs Malik Newman |url=https://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-signs-malik-newman |website=NBA.com |access-date=August 6, 2018 |date=August 6, 2018}}</ref> He was waived on October 7.<ref>{{cite web |title=Miami Heat sign Charles Cooke, DeAndre Liggins |url=http://www.nba.com/article/2018/10/07/miami-heat-cooke-liggins-official-release/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=October 7, 2018 |date=October 7, 2018}}</ref> Newman was signed by the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] of the [[NBA G League]] on October 10.<ref>{{cite news |title=Malik Newman: Inks deal in G-League |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/malik-newman-inks-deal-in-g-league/ |access-date=October 12, 2018 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=October 10, 2018}}</ref> In 17 games with the Skyforce, Newman averaged 9.5 points and 2.6 rebounds per game.

===Canton Charge (2019–2020)===
On January 5, 2019, Newman was traded to the [[Canton Charge]] for forward [[Emanuel Terry]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Charge Acquire Malik Newman |url=https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-acquire-malik-newman/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=January 5, 2019 |date=January 5, 2019 |archive-date=January 6, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190106104628/https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/charge-acquire-malik-newman/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> On November 21, Newman had 26 points, three rebounds, four assists, and three steals during a win over the [[Erie BayHawks (2019–)|Erie BayHawks]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Malik Newman: Leads team in win |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/malik-newman-leads-team-in-win/ |access-date=February 7, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=November 22, 2019}}</ref> In January 2020, he scored over 20 points in five straight games.<ref>{{cite news |title=Malik Newman: Paces team in loss |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/malik-newman-paces-team-in-loss/ |access-date=February 7, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=February 7, 2020}}</ref> Newman finished second on the team in scoring at 16.1 points per game.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Amico |first1=Sam |title=Charge's banner year comes to end as G League cancels season |url=https://www.si.com/nba/cavaliers/nba-amico/canton-charge-g-league-season |access-date=June 28, 2020 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=June 4, 2020}}</ref>

===Cleveland Cavaliers (2020)===
On February 9, 2020, the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] announced that they had signed Newman to a 10-day contract.<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign J.P. Macura And Malik Newman To 10-Day Contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/macura-newman-contracts-200209|date=February 9, 2020|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 9, 2020}}</ref>  Newman made his NBA debut that evening against the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] and scored two points on a pair of free throws in four minutes of action. It was his only NBA regular-season appearance.

===Bursaspor (2020–2021)===
On June 29, 2020, Newman signed with [[Bursaspor Basketbol|Frutti Extra Bursaspor]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish Super League]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/malik-newman-inks-with-bursaspor/|title=Malik Newman inks with Bursaspor|date=June 29, 2020|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=June 29, 2020}}</ref>

===Ironi Nahariya (2021)===
On January 16, 2021, Newman signed with [[Ironi Nahariya]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/malik-newman-signs-with-ironi-nahariya/|title=Malik Newman signs with Ironi Nahariya|last=|first=|date=January 16, 2021|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=January 16, 2021}}</ref> In 2020-21 he was third in the Israel Basketball Premier League in free throw percentage (91.8 per cent).<ref>{{cite web | url=http://old.scouting4u.com/35,3,0,0/israel-basketball-leaders | title=Israel basketball stats, results, box score, scout report and video online | Scouting4U }}</ref>

===Cleveland Charge (2021)===
On October 23, 2021, Newman signed with the [[Cleveland Charge]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Cleveland Charge 2021-22 Training Camp Roster|url=https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/cleveland-charge-2021-22-training-camp-roster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2021|access-date=October 24, 2021}}</ref> He averaged 17.8 points, 3.2 rebounds and 3.9 assists per game.<ref name="cavsign" />

===Cleveland Cavaliers (2021–2022)===
On December 29, 2021, Newman signed a 10-day contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers via the NBA's hardship exception.<ref name="cavsign">{{cite web |title=Cavaliers Sign Malik Newman |url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/newman-signing-211229 |website=NBA.com |access-date=December 30, 2021 |date=December 29, 2021}}</ref>

===Return to the Charge (2022)===
On January 8, 2022, Newman was reacquired by the [[Cleveland Charge]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League transactions|date=January 8, 2022|access-date=January 8, 2022}}</ref> On March 28, he was waived after suffering a season-ending injury.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kyle Guy Returns to Charge|url=https://canton.gleague.nba.com/news/kyle-guy-returns-to-charge/|website=NBA.com|date=March 28, 2022|access-date=March 29, 2022}}</ref>

===Avtodor Saratov (2022–2024)===
On November 5, 2022, he signed with [[BC Avtodor|Avtodor Saratov]] of the [[VTB United League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/bc-avtodor-saratov-signs-malik-newman-danilo-nikolic/|title=BC Avtodor Saratov signs Malik Newman, Danilo Nikolic|last=|first=|date=November 5, 2022|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=November 5, 2022}}</ref>

===Napoli Basket (2024–2025)===
On December 9, 2024, Newman signed with [[Napoli Basket (2016)|Napoli Basket]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Napoli Basket signs Malik Newman |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/napoli-basket-signs-malik-newman/ |website=Sportando |access-date=December 9, 2024 |date=December 9, 2024}}</ref>

===Merkezefendi Basket (2025)===
On January 16, 2025, he signed with [[Merkezefendi Belediyesi Denizli Basket|Merkezefendi Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite tweet |user=merkezefendigsk |number=1879966401814822949 |title=Malik Newman, sezonun devamında #BuŞehrinTakımı için oynayacak.}}</ref>

=== Avtodor Saratov (2025-present) ===
On August 29, 2025, Newman signed with [[BC Avtodor|Avtodor Saratov]] of the [[VTB United League]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Малик Ньюмэн возвращается в Саратов! — АВТОДОР |url=https://avtodor.ru/malik-newman-is-coming-back-to-saratov/ |access-date=2025-08-29 |language=ru-RU}}</ref>
